t: Topological Quantum Computer: Braiding Matrix Desk — Simple
name: Topological Quantum Computer: Braiding Matrix Desk — Simple
title: Topological Quantum Computer: Braiding Matrix Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Braids are matrices: the desk computes the unitary for an anyon exchange in the Fibonacci model — the R-matrix phases are exact, and the braid word multiplies them. The computation is the gate.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Hilbert dimension of 4 Fibonacci anyons = 5 states. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Topological Quantum Computer: Knot Complexity vs. Fixed Braiding Length
real_world_basis: Braiding-matrix computation is the real basis of topological quantum gates.
signature_version: Signature version: the fixed-braiding matrix desk — the chapter's Fixed Braiding Length as the depth target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the braid word is the program — verify it by matrix multiplication.
math_note: Hilbert dimension of 4 Fibonacci anyons: 5 states [verified]; Quantum dimension of Fibonacci anyon: 1.618 dimension [verified]

math_check.label: Hilbert dimension of 4 Fibonacci anyons
math_check.note: corrected 2026-10-19: was '3'; fusion dimension for 4 anyons is Fib(5)=5

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a braid word that doesn't compute to the target.
how_it_works: Multiply the R-matrices per the braid word. The demo braids three Fibonacci anyons.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
